newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down 10 cents on London's fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down 10 cents on London's fall.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed 10 cents lower at 14.10 ringgit ($5.63) a kg, pressured by a $55-drop on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, traders said.

They said buying from Europe, Japan and Malaysia only appeared at the lower level. "Where the market is going would depend very much on LME's performance. But the price should be able to hold above 14 ringgit," said one trader.
Turnover was 81 tonnes, down from 125 on Thursday.
The local price premium over LME has widened to $85 a tonne from $65 previously, the traders said. ($1=2.5040 ringgit)
